name: neighbours
description: Reads the firewall's ARP (IPv4) and NDP (IPv6) neighbour tables: the address, hardware address, interface and vendor of each neighbour, the client identity of last resort on a firewall whose DHCP is unreadable.

endpoints.name: arp
endpoints.note: getArpAction runs the configd action `interface list arp json` (scripts/interfaces/list_arp.py: one row per complete entry with mac, ip, intf, expired, expires, permanent, type, manufacturer, hostname) and adds intf_description. Read without `resolve`, so no name lookup runs on the firewall. https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/scripts/interfaces/list_arp.py

endpoints.name: ndp
endpoints.note: getNdpAction runs the configd action `interface list ndp json` (scripts/interfaces/list_ndp.py: one row per complete entry with ip, mac, intf, manufacturer) and adds intf_description. https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/26.7.3/src/opnsense/scripts/interfaces/list_ndp.py
